visualStyleNotes: Data And Statistics, Math palette, Anatomy Atelier bar: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. A tidy tally board with color chip columns rising from a base, each with a counter chip and the tallest column highlighted. Soft neutral studio light, no rim-light glow, no bloom, no emissive. Strong saturated color reserved for the small flat hotspot dots (amber / molecular-green / grid-blue from the Math palette). Specimen-quality clean-3D, not cartoon, not cluttered.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere. Tally board: warm paper panel (roughness ~0.5). Chips: small warm paper tiles in desaturated colors (Blue, Red, Green) stacked into columns. Counter chips: small warm paper tiles with ink tallies on each column. Mode winner: amber glow-cue plate under the tallest column. Mat: soft warm-grey (roughness ~0.85). No emissive channels — highlights handled by app runtime UI.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: the mode as the most frequent value — a board of color chip columns with a counter per color; tapping adds chips; a tie preset shows bimodal; a reset equalizes and shows 'no mode'.

GEOMETRY: A tidy board with three color columns (Blue, Red, Green) of stacked chips. Each column has a small counter plate showing its count. Tapping a color adds a chip and ticks the counter; the tallest column glows under an amber marker as the mode. 'Tie' preset adds chips so two columns reach equal tops — both glow as bimodal. 'Reset' sets equal chips on every column with no winner.

LAYERS (toggleable): (1) board; (2) color columns; (3) counters; (4) mode marker.

CAMERA: three-quarter from front, slightly above, frames the board; labels legible. Budget 5-9k triangles. Named nodes: Board, ColumnBlue, ColumnRed, ColumnGreen, CounterPlates, ModeMarker, TieCue, ResetBtn. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer.
